current.title: Pati Ka Fareb
current.logline: Nisha apne mamaji ki maut ke baad unki textile empire ki akeli waris bani. Uska pati Rohan, jise woh apni duniya maanti thi, uski sabse badi kamzori ban gaya... kyunki Rohan ne uski daulat ke liye uske saath shaadi ka dhong kiya tha.

Nisha.role: Recently widowed heir to Vardaan Textiles.
Nisha.secret: Unaware of her husband's true intentions.
Nisha.want: To honor her mamaji's legacy and build a loving family.

Rohan.secret: Deeply in debt, he married Nisha only for her inheritance.
Rohan.want: To steal Nisha's entire empire and live a lavish life.

Aryan.role: Rohan's former business partner and co-founder of Vardaan Textiles.
Aryan.secret: Rohan previously defrauded him, so he holds crucial information.
Aryan.want: Justice and to reclaim his rightful share of the company.

arc: Part 1: Nisha apne mamaji ke guzar jaane ke gham mein doobi thi, jab lawyer ne use Vardaan Textiles ka sole heir ghoshit kiya. Rohan ne usse kaha, 'Yeh sab business hai, tumhe kya samajh aayega? Main hoon na.' Usne Nisha ko Pyar aur Bharose ke naam par Power of Attorney sign karne ko manaya. Nisha ne kaanpte haathon se papers par sign kar diye. Rohan ne phone par muskurate hue kaha, 'Kaam ho gaya. Ab Vardaan Textiles mera hai.'

Part 2: Rohan ne naye luxury items par kharch karna shuru kar diya, lekin Nisha ya ghar ke liye kuch nahi. Jab Nisha ne factory jaane ki baat ki toh Rohan ne use rok diya, 'Abhi bahut paperwork hai, tum tension mat lo.' Usne Nisha ko 'just a housewife' keh kar uske ideas ko dismiss kiya. Rohan ne Aryan ka naam liya, 'Woh Aryan na, mera purana partner. Bahut jalebi aadmi hai, humesha sab kharab karna chahta hai.' Nisha ne Rohan ko phone par yeh kehte suna, 'Aryan ko nikalne ke liye yeh sab plan banana pada. Ab Nisha mere control mein hai.' Nisha galti se samajh baithi ki Rohan use Aryan se bacha raha hai. Rohan ne ek nayi ghadi pehni, 'Yeh dekho, pehli business deal se profit. Tumhare liye toh main kuch bhi karunga, jaan.' Nisha muskurayi, lekin uske mann mein ek halka sa shaq aaya, dekhte hue ki ghadi kitni mehengi thi.

Part 3: Ek family dinner par, Rohan ne Vardaan Textiles ko 'apni' company bata kar boast kiya. Nisha ne kuch kehne ki koshish ki, lekin Rohan ne use beech mein hi tok diya, 'Tumhe toh business ka 'B' bhi nahi pata, jaan.' Nisha ne chupke se factory jaane ka faisla kiya. Wahan uski mulaqat Aryan se hui. Aryan ne use dekh kar halki si warning di, 'Apne papers dhyan se check kar lena, ma'am. Kuch log rishton ka faayda uthate hain.' Rohan wahan aa gaya, Nisha aur Aryan ko saath dekh kar gusse mein bola, 'Tum yahan kya kar rahi ho? Ghar jao! Guests aa rahe hain.' Nisha, sharminda hokar wahan se chali gayi. Uss raat, ek khoi hui earring dhundhte hue, Nisha ko Rohan ke desk mein ek secret drawer mila. Andar, use apne mamaji ki original will, aur ek *alag* document mila: ek share transfer agreement, jo Rohan ko 100% owner banata tha, aur uspar Nisha ke *jaali* signature the. Nisha ka haath kaanp raha tha, us jaali signature ko dekhte hue. 'Yeh... yeh kya hai?'

Part 4: Nisha ne Rohan ko us document ke saath confront kiya. Rohan ne turant gaslighting shuru kar di, 'Yeh fake hai! Aryan ne banaya hoga tumhe phansane ke liye! Woh mujhse jal raha hai!' Nisha ne, however, us 'N' mein ek halka sa variation pehchan liya, jo woh jaanti thi ki uska nahi tha. Usne Rohan par vishwas karne ka natak kiya, 'Oh, toh Aryan itna ghatiya hai?' Nisha ne chupke se ek handwriting expert ko contact kiya, jisne forgery confirm kar di. Nisha ne Rohan ke purane bank statements, uske burner phone par secret calls, aur uske lawyer ke saath meetings ke evidence jama karna shuru kar diya. Use realize hua ki Rohan ne usse sirf uski property ke liye shaadi ki thi. Nisha ne Aryan ko call kiya. 'Mr. Aryan? Mujhe aapse milna hai... ek urgent business proposal ke liye. Aur haan, main Nisha... Vardaan Textiles ki *asli* owner.'

Part 5: Nisha ne Aryan se mulaqat ki aur Rohan ke khilaf saare saboot rakhe. Aryan shocked tha, lekin uski baat sach sabit hui. Usne bataya ki Rohan ne pehle bhi uski company mein hissa churaya tha. Unhone milkar ek plan banaya. Nisha ne Rohan ke saamne aur bhi submissive act kiya, use lagne diya ki woh jeet gaya hai. Rohan ne ek badi board meeting plan ki thi, jisme woh Vardaan Textiles par apni complete control announce karne wala tha. Nisha aur Aryan ne original will aur forged documents ko us board meeting mein reveal karne ka trap set kiya. Board meeting shuru hui. Rohan confident chalte hue aaya, Nisha par smirk kiya aur head seat par baith gaya. 'Toh shuru karein?'

Part 6: Rohan ne meeting shuru ki aur apne plans bataye. Nisha chupchaap use dekhti rahi. Rohan ne baaki saare assets ko transfer karne aur apni control pakka karne ke liye final resolution maanga. Jaise hi woh sign karne wala tha, Nisha ne use roka, 'Ek minute, Rohan.' Woh khadi hui, projector screen badli, aur forged document ko uske asli signature ke saath dikhaya gaya, Handwriting expert ki report ke saath. 'Yeh hai woh dhoka jo tumne kiya, Rohan. Aur yeh hai Mr. Aryan, Vardaan Textiles ke asli co-owner, jise tumne dhoke se nikala.' Rohan gusse mein pagal ho gaya, use chup karwane ki koshish ki, 'Yeh sab jhooth hai! Nisha, tum pagal ho gayi ho!' Aryan ne Rohan ke financial fraud aur company funds ko manipulate karne ke saboot pesh kiye. Board members Rohan ke khilaf ho gaye. Lawyer ne forgery aur fraud ke legal ramifications confirm kiye. Rohan ko publicly humiliated kiya gaya, uski saari power cheen li gayi, aur police ne use arrest kar liya. Nisha Vardaan Textiles ke board table ke head par khadi thi, uski aankhon mein thandi, determined chamak thi. 'Ab, Mr. Aryan,' usne kaha, 'humara kaam shuru hota hai.'
current.soFar: Mamaji ki maut ke gham mein doobi Nisha Vardaan Textiles ki akeli waris bani. Uska pati Rohan, jise woh apni duniya maanti thi, uski kamzori ban gaya. Rohan ne Nisha ko pyar aur bharose ke naam par Power of Attorney sign karne ko manaya. Nisha ne kaanpte haathon se papers par sign kar diye, anjaan ki uska pati uski daulat ke liye uske saath fareb kar raha tha.
